description: This is a PHP source file defining the class 'Setting' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Setting'. It contains methods to retrieve configuration settings from a database for the OpenCart system, including methods like getSettings, getSetting, and getValue.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Represents the model for retrieving store settings in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a given store ID, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches settings for a specific code (group) and store ID, returning an array of settings.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single setting value by key for a given store ID.
